title: Council notes — rotation into majors
body: Council flagged the rotation from alts back into BTC/ETH over the last 36h. We trimmed SOL into strength per the latest report and are sizing up BTC and ETH modestly. Risk: crowded long on SOL and a potential squeeze if BTC cools.

title: Re-entered ETH on L2 catalyst
body: L2 daily tx counts hit a 30-day high. Added 2.4 ETH at 3020 with stop under 2980. Reasoning: relative strength + on-chain confirmation, with DCI still trending up. Target 3.2k zone.

title: ADA recovery — early add
body: Took a starter position in ADA on the recovery phase DCI cross above 60. Sizing kept small (1.2% of book) given low liquidity depth. Plan: add on a pullback to 0.328 with confirmation.

title: BTC add-on after consolidation
body: Added 0.15 BTC at 65800 after a clean 4h consolidation. Trail stop under 66.4k. Reasoning: structure remains bullish, funding neutral, breadth confirming.

title: Stopped on ETH false breakout
body: Took a -0.84% loss on a 2-ETH long that failed at the 3k breakout. Review: breakout was on low volume and into weekend liquidity. Will require volume-confirmed breakouts going forward.
